name: 3D aquarium live wallpaper
description: Every third-party asset slot for the aquarium wallpaper, with the licence it ships under. Checked by scripts/aquarium-assets.mjs; see docs/AQUARIUM-ASSETS.md for why the licences are filtered the way they are.
distributionNote: The wallpaper ships loose glTF inside an APK, which is a zip. Anything a user can rename-and-open counts as distributed standalone, so marketplace royalty-free licences are refused until distribution becomes 'packed'.

assets.title: LowPoly Animated Fish
assets.author: Quaternius
assets.notes: Rigged with a swim animation per species. Convert to glTF on import; keep the rig, the wallpaper drives the swim clip by flow speed.

assets.title: Animated Cute Fish Pack
assets.author: Quaternius
assets.notes: Stylised alternative to the pack above. Pick one art direction; mixing the two reads as asset-flipped.

assets.title: Animated Fish Bundle
assets.author: Quaternius
assets.notes: Seven models served as glTF directly, so no conversion step. Same author as the itch packs; take whichever format saves the pipeline work.

assets.title: Coral type specimens (Open Access)
assets.author: Smithsonian Institution
assets.notes: Photogrammetry at millions of triangles. Decimate to roughly 3k and bake normals before shipping. Take from 3d.si.edu, not Sketchfab, whose CC0 downloads were excluded from the Fab migration.

assets.title: PBR substrate set (sand, gravel, wet rock, algae, glass)
assets.author: ambientCG
assets.notes: 1K is enough at wallpaper viewing distance; 2K only for the substrate the camera sits closest to. Ship basis/KTX2, not PNG.

assets.title: Interior HDRI for the light outside the glass
assets.author: Poly Haven
assets.notes: Only needed for the reflection in the front glass. A 1K HDRI, or a baked irradiance probe, keeps the APK small.

assets.title: Aquatic plants (geometry nodes)
assets.author: this project
assets.notes: Generated, not sourced — bend field driven by the same flow that carries the fish, as the shaker does for glitter.

assets.title: Tank, glass, bezel, water volume
assets.author: this project
assets.notes: Parametric. The refracting rim in wallpaper/index.html is the same construction at a different scale.

assets.title: Caustics, god rays, bubbles, silt
assets.author: this project
assets.notes: Shader and particles. Licensing a caustics texture buys a loop that does not match the water it is cast by.
